name: ai-chat-panel
description: One chat for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and GitHub Copilot in VS Code and Antigravity IDE.

commands.title: Clanker Controller: Show Log in Output Panel
Clanker Controller:Run Scheduled Prompts While the Editor Is Closed
Clanker Controller:Route Prompt to a Routed-Prompts Chat
Clanker Controller:Run Next Batch in Clean Session

aiChatPanel.timeFormat.markdownDescription: Clock format for times in the chat panel and launcher. `auto` follows the editor's display language.

enumDescriptions: Two half circles: Gemini models and Gemini 4 Argon, each with its own percentage and reset
Gemini 4 Argon, its 7-day window as one circle
aiChatPanel.antigravityRing.markdownDescription: Which Antigravity usage the launcher's Gemini circle shows. `split` divides it into one arc per pool. The hover card always lists every group.

enumDescriptions: Use the name the agent gives the chat where it gives one (Antigravity does); Groq names chats from Claude Code and Codex, which don't
Always have Groq name new chats
aiChatPanel.chatNames.markdownDescription: Who names a new chat. `agent` takes the title the agent wrote itself once its first turn is under way, and falls back to Groq when there is none. `groq` always asks Groq (needs a Groq key in Settings > Routing; without one, chats are named from their first words).

aiChatPanel.railProjects.markdownDescription: How many projects the sidebar rail shows. The chat's own project always stays visible, then your pinned favorites (at most 2), then the most recent. `0` shows every project, for very large monitors. Chat Settings > General has the picker.

aiChatPanel.railChats.markdownDescription: How many recent chats the sidebar rail lists. Running and recently used chats come first. `0` lists every chat, for very large monitors. Chat Settings > General has the picker.

aiChatPanel.completionSound.markdownDescription: Play the notification chime when a reply finishes and nothing you queued is left to run. Turn off for silence; the desktop notification shown while the IDE is in the background is unaffected. Chat Settings > General has the switch.

aiChatPanel.openFailedToolCards.markdownDescription: Open a tool step by itself when it fails, so its error is on screen without a click. Off by default: a failed step stays folded (its row still turns red and says Failed) and opens when you click it. Chat Settings > General has the switch.

aiChatPanel.oomGuard.markdownDescription: Linux: keep the editor alive when memory runs out, so running and queued prompts survive. Clanker sets systemd's `OOMPolicy=continue` for VS Code's app unit (a killed language server no longer stops all of VS Code), gives VS Code and the CLIs the lowest kill priority your user may set, makes other desktop apps (not the desktop itself, terminals or editors) the kernel's first choice while prompts run or wait, closes idle warm CLI sessions, and holds a queued prompt back while memory is very low. No root needed; the files are in `~/.config/systemd/user/app-code-.scope.d/` and `app-code@.service.d/`.

enumDescriptions: Every control in view: the sidebar rail with usage, projects and recent chats, tool cards and the full composer.
Minimal: a slim header instead of the rail, a softer transcript with each turn's steps folded into one pill, and only the composer controls you use most. Follows your colour theme.
aiChatPanel.appearance.markdownDescription: How the chat looks. **Clanker** shows every control; **Halo** is the minimal look: fewer buttons, folded work steps and a glow round the message box while a reply is being written. Switches open chats at once. Chat Settings > General has the picker.

aiChatPanel.workContextIcons.markdownDescription: Show what each Recent chat is working on as a small icon, chosen by Cloudflare's Clef Flash. **Turn on only if the Cloudflare account connected in Settings > Routing is on the Workers Free plan.** Clanker cannot check your plan. The feature spends at most 1,000 of Cloudflare's 10,000 free Neurons a day (about 250 classifications) and stops when 8,000 are used; it never falls back to another provider and does nothing without a Cloudflare connection.

aiChatPanel.chatFolders.markdownDescription: Group chats into folders in Manage Chats and expand them from the sidebar's Recent list. Turn off to hide folder controls and show every chat flat without deleting your folders. Chat Settings > General has the switch.

aiChatPanel.livePrices.markdownDescription: Keep the API prices behind the *API value* figure current by reading the community price table once a day (LiteLLM, raw.githubusercontent.com). Off: only the prices that ship with the extension are used.

aiChatPanel.voiceAutoStopSeconds.markdownDescription: Dictation stops and transcribes by itself after this many seconds of silence once you have spoken. `0` keeps recording until you stop it.

aiChatPanel.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show Clanker Controller's item (the Cloudflare tunnel state) in the status bar at the bottom of the window.

aiChatPanel.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Permission mode across Claude, Codex, and Gemini: `ask` requests approval where the provider supports prompts, `auto` uses automated risk review where supported, and `fullAccess` allows automatic execution. Headless Gemini skips actions requiring approval in `ask` and `auto`.

aiChatPanel.verifyCommand.markdownDescription: What Auto-Verify (the check-mark button beside the composer's clock) tells the agent to run after it changes files, for example `npm test`. Empty: the agent finds the project's own test or verify command.

aiChatPanel.architectModel.markdownDescription: The discovered model id that plans when you send `/architect <task>`. Empty uses the current Claude default. It reads the code and writes a plan, and edits nothing.

aiChatPanel.editorModel.markdownDescription: The discovered model id that builds the plan after `/architect`. Empty uses the current Codex default. It starts by itself when the plan is done.

aiChatPanel.autoContinueOnLimit.markdownDescription: Automatically schedule Continue in the same chat and model when a task hits its usage limit. It resumes when usage resets, ahead of later prompts. Disable in Chat Settings > General to schedule Continue manually.

aiChatPanel.autoUpdateClis.markdownDescription: Silently update outdated connected provider CLIs while they have no active work and you have not typed with them for 30 seconds. Other providers can update while you chat. Turn off to use manual updates. Chat Settings > General has the switch.

aiChatPanel.autoUpdateApps.markdownDescription: Also update desktop apps installed from an apt repository (the ChatGPT app, Claude Desktop) while they have no active work. Each update asks for your system password in the system's own dialog, so this is off by default; a dismissed dialog is not shown again for six hours. Without this, Settings shows an Update button.

aiChatPanel.confirmExternalLinks.description: Ask before opening an external link from Clanker chat. Chat Settings > General has the switch.

aiChatPanel.cliTelemetry.markdownDescription: Off blocks telemetry for Codex and Claude Code and disables Agy feedback surveys. Reload the editor to apply changes to running processes. Agy's account-level telemetry has no headless CLI flag and is controlled via Enable Telemetry in its /config menu.

aiChatPanel.sessionWarmup.markdownDescription: In the background, send "respond with 1" to the cheapest model of each connected CLI whenever its 5-hour usage window isn't running and no prompt is queued for its usage reset, so a window is nearly always already under way when you start. It repeats every 5 hours while the IDE is running. On by default, but only for CLIs signed in with a subscription: a CLI billed per token through an API key is never pinged. Chat Settings > General has the switch.

aiChatPanel.droidSounds.markdownDescription: Clanker's own sound when a turn ends: a rising astromech chirp when it's done, a low warble when the agent reports an error. Synthesized in the chat window (no audio files). Off by default; the completion chime your CLI hooks play is separate.

aiChatPanel.investigationsMaxParallel.markdownDescription: How many loops may run at once, for example one per project. Each run still reserves its token allowance from the shared hourly limit and checks spare quota before it starts.

aiChatPanel.investigationsMaxAgents.markdownDescription: How many model calls and fixers all loops together may have running at the same moment. One loop starts about ten scouts at once; lower this if your provider rate-limits you.

scout.markdownDescription: Model for the scouts, verifiers and fix judges. `auto` (or unset) picks Gemini Flash, then Claude, then Codex, whichever is installed.

editor.markdownDescription: Model that makes backend fixes. `auto` picks Codex, then Claude. Gemini edits only when you choose it here, or when nothing else is installed.

visualEditor.markdownDescription: Model that makes layout and styling fixes. `auto` picks Claude, then Codex. Gemini edits only when you choose it here, or when nothing else is installed.

vision.markdownDescription: Model that looks at screenshots. Needs an Antigravity (Gemini) model.

aiChatPanel.investigationsModels.markdownDescription: Which model does which job in a loop. Each value is a model id (for example `gemini-3.8-flash-high`), an agent name (`gemini`, `claude`, `codex`) or `auto`. The Loops window changes this too.

aiChatPanel.complianceScout.markdownDescription: Adds an EU compliance scout to every full loop and runs the free text checks for GDPR and TDDDG indicators (remote fonts, trackers, CDNs, embeds, missing imprint or privacy page, forms without a notice, personal data in logs). Findings are indicators for you to judge, never legal advice, and are never fixed automatically. Set in Chat Settings > Loops.

aiChatPanel.complianceRedact.markdownDescription: Before a loop sends project text to a cloud model, replaces real-looking e-mail addresses, IBANs and phone numbers with placeholders. Your own files and the private copy the editors work in are not changed. Set in Chat Settings > Loops.

aiChatPanel.investigationsVisualAgent.markdownDescription: Which agent fixes visual problems (layout, styling, rendering) in a fix loop. If it is off, not installed or short on quota, the other agent is used.

aiChatPanel.investigationsBackendAgent.markdownDescription: Which agent fixes backend problems in a fix loop. Claude edits with Sonnet (Opus on a second attempt at the same problem). If it is off, not installed or short on quota, the other agent is used.

aiChatPanel.voiceHotkey.markdownDescription: Global hotkey for dictation, e.g. `Ctrl+Alt+Space` or `F9` (Windows only). Works from any app, not only this window; the keys still reach the app in front. Set it in Chat Settings > Voice. Empty: off. On Linux, bind a desktop shortcut to `scripts/linux/clanker-dictate` instead.

aiChatPanel.voiceHotkeyMode.markdownDescription: How the dictation hotkey behaves. `toggle`: press once to start, press again to stop and transcribe. `hold`: record while the keys are held, transcribe on release.

aiChatPanel.voiceSounds.markdownDescription: Play a short tone when dictation starts recording and when it stops, so you know the microphone is live.

aiChatPanel.voicePauseMedia.markdownDescription: Pause background music and videos while dictating, then resume the media dictation paused when recording ends. Applies to apps supporting Windows media controls, and on Linux to MPRIS players (browsers, Spotify, VLC, mpv).

aiChatPanel.voiceMicDevice.markdownDescription: Microphone for dictation, by its device name. Set it in Chat Settings > Voice. Empty: automatic (the system's default input; Settings shows which one). A device that is not connected falls back to automatic.

aiChatPanel.voiceProvider.markdownDescription: Speech-to-text backend for dictation. `groq` (default) uses Groq's cloud Whisper API. `local` runs whisper.cpp on this machine using a model downloaded on demand in Chat Settings > Voice.

aiChatPanel.voiceGroqModel.markdownDescription: Whisper model used when dictation runs on Groq. `whisper-large-v3-turbo` is fastest and cheapest; `whisper-large-v3` offers slightly higher accuracy.

aiChatPanel.voiceLocalModel.markdownDescription: On-device whisper.cpp model used when `aiChatPanel.voiceProvider` is `local`. Includes English-only (`*.en`) and Multilingual models; downloaded on demand outside this workspace.

aiChatPanel.models.description: Optional CLI model overrides. Empty uses the dynamically discovered models.

scripts.test: node test/check.js && node test/session.test.js && node test/turn-undo.test.js && node test/turn-extras.test.js && node --test test/turn-queue.test.js test/cli-tools.test.js
